title: Every time analysis declares its date basis; resurfaced signal
description:
Audit trend/snapshot/signal code so each series names dateBasis (ingestion|publication) per design 2.3; concept trend reports and wiki timelines use publication date with flagged fallback. Add the resurfaced signal: References whose publication-to-ingestion gap is high against the site's own gap distribution and that got recent attention (Messages, accepts, new edges); pack says what pointed attention at it.
Tests + Gherkin.
Owner rules that apply: no fixed caps, day windows or magic thresholds (derive or learn them; bound only by time, cost, context size); decisions go to decision models (Jev / the site Cyclotron), the LLM (GPT-6 Luna) only writes; Gherkin specs (narrative, complete) for every behaviour change; say "idea(s)", never "draft"/"proposed story".
